messages:
ops-bot: PAGER ALERT: Multiple model-serving jobs in cluster 'prod-infer-1' reporting stalled collectives and GPU resets — severity: P1. Count: 7 tasks across 3 nodes. Suggested runbook: mlagent/collective-failure.
nora_oncall: I'm on it. @kevin_sre can you grab the hardware side? I'm pulling logs and pid traces.
maria_eng: looking at the request graph — these are pipeline-parallel jobs hitting allreduce during backward. Possibly KV cache eviction spike?
kevin_sre: ack. pinging infra to check for node flaps. Pulling dmesg now.
sam_support: customer-impact: a few customers reported degraded generation latency ~1.5-3s spikes in the last 2 minutes. No widespread 5xx yet.
kevin_sre: dmesg shows repeated GPU resets and a cuda:Xid error on node gpu-24: "Xid 79, GPU reset required". Also some kernel oops lines around nvlink timeouts.
derek_lead: if nodes are unstable, we should failover the affected workloads to fallback-single-gpu variants to keep user-facing latency predictable. Can we route?
nora_oncall: start migration: set route weight for model-route 'text-gen-v2' to fallback_pool=100%. I'll patch the routing policy now.
maria_eng: posted a quick command to drain one node for repro and logs: ```kubectl drain gpu-24 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force```
kevin_sre: executing debug steps: collecting driver version & nv_peer_memory status: ```ssh gpu-24 sudo nvidia-smi -q | egrep 'Driver Version|GPU UUID' && sudo systemctl status nv_peer_mem || true```
kevin_sre: driver mismatch found: node shows driver 525.x while others at 535.x — likely inter-node fabric incompatibility under NCCL. Also observed transient IB flaps in syslog before resets.
nora_oncall: routing change applied — traffic for the route shifted to fallback pool. Observed 90% drop in affected requests within 30s. Customers routed to fallback see slightly higher token cost but stable latency. :white_check_mark:
sam_support: notifying customers in impacted orgs: short status posted to status page and to a small set of customer contacts. Reference id INC-5487654321.
maria_eng: as a mitigation let's cordon nodes gpu-24/gpu-25/gpu-26, drain remaining jobs, and schedule immediate reboot + driver rollback to 535. I'll coordinate with infra.
kevin_sre: cordoned and started drains. Captured core dumps from one stuck container: ```gdb -c core.1234 --batch -ex 'bt full' > /tmp/core-backtrace.txt``` — pushing artifact to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/5487654321/
derek_lead: good mitigation. Keep me posted on ETA to restore capacity. Also please capture the exact NCCL version and topology map for postmortem.
kevin_sre: reboot completed on gpu-24; driver now 535. Rejoined cluster and NVLink reports clean. Re-running a small smoke test for multi-GPU allreduce.
maria_eng: smoke tests passing on gpu-24. Bringing capacity back: uncordon gpu-24 and re-enable model-route weight in stages 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%.
nora_oncall: starting staged rollout. Monitoring token-level latency and error rate.
sam_support: customer update: informed impacted companies that we've started restore and expect full service within 20-30m.
kevin_sre: after rejoin, no further Xid79s on gpu-24. Nodes gpu-25/26 still draining. Observed that one pod had an older NCCL package pinned — will include in mitigation notes.
maria_eng: rollback completed and staged traffic back to 60% with green health checks. No regressions for 5 minutes.
derek_lead: please create a follow-up ticket: "driver-version-enforcement + NCCL compatibility check as pre-deploy gating" and prioritize. Also add an alert for diverging driver versions across node pools.
nora_oncall: incident status: mitigated. Impact window ~00:06 - 00:34 UTC (approx 28m). Affected customers: small subset using large batch pipeline runs; user-facing latency spikes while route was failing over.
sam_support: posted final customer update and closed the temporary status note.
kevin_sre: capturing final artifacts (dmesg, syslogs, nvlink topo, container logs) to the incident bucket. Will attach to postmortem.
maria_eng: immediate action items: 1) enforce driver pinning via node bootstrap 2) add NCCL version check in CI 3) add KV-cache eviction guardrail to prevent prefix thrash during collective boundary.
derek_lead: +1. Assigning owners: infra for driver pinning (kevin_sre), eng-ml for NCCL CI check (maria_eng), runtime for KV guard (nora_oncall).
nora_oncall: handing off to postmortem owner @derek_lead. Closing on-call hand. If anything spikes, reopen. :lock:
derek_lead: logged INC-5487654321 in tracker and set high priority for follow-ups. Thanks all for fast response.
ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-5487654321 marked mitigated by nora_oncall at ts 5487654520. Artifacts: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/5487654321/"
